notes.title: Patch Notes 1.3
notes.content:
Today, we're excited to release Patch 1.3, which adds new content, such as a bonus post-credits scene, and includes a bevy of bug fixes and improvements. Learn about this latest update in the below patch notes. 

Patch 1.3
NEW! 

 Bonus post-credits scene 
 Interactive content warning screen 
 “Skip text” feature, available after finishing the entire game 
 Global offset calibrator for rhythm minigames 
 Lane speed setting for Mania-like rhythm minigame 
 New videoke minigame song: Leron Leron Sinta 
 More graphics settings (reflections, SSAO, and an Off option for almost every setting) 
 Credits now accessible from the main menu at any time 


Fixes and improvements:  
 Fixed audio crackling in Windows 
 Improved general behavior of controller icons 
 Fixed gamepad icons appearing even though keyboard is in use 
 Fixed inconsistent timings in the jeepney minigame (but still as hard) 
 Fixed mouse clicks not registering in the League of Mashers minigame 
 Various visual improvements in the League of Mashers minigame 
 Fixed various soft-locks, especially those that occur under low framerates 
 Fixed FPS HUD not letting mouse clicks through 
 Fixed certain music tracks not looping 
 Fixed some English typographical errors 
 Fixed the “Fishballer” achievement not unlocking if player skewers more than one fishball in a single turn 
 Fixed some SFX and music tracks not respecting volume settings 
 Fixed Mark’s rare moonwalking/moonrunning in certain scenes 
 Improved intro music track 
 Improved gamepad navigation in scene selector 
 Fixed Mark’s chat messages possibly being sent more than once 
 Improved physics and feel of the web browser dinosaur minigame 

 Spoilers ahead! Fixes continued:  

[spoiler] 
 Fixed Mark’s arms in front of Nicole during their prom dance 
 Fixed erroneous physics when removing a certain pushpin in Part 1, Chapter 4 “Real Part” 
 Fixed the game not pausing after finishing a practice piece in Part 1, Chapter 5 “Last Practice” 
 Fixed the metronome setting of “100 Progressive Studies” in Part 1, Chapter 5 “Last Practice” 
 Fixed more than one Cathy appearing at the same time in Part 2, Chapter 5 “Audition Day” 
 Fixed the arrow icon getting stuck in Part 2, Chapter 5 “Save Me, Please” 
 Fixed Mark unnecessarily standing up in Part 3, Chapter 5 “Until Then” 
 Fixed visual artifacts of trees and branches in Part 3, Chapter 5 “Until Then” 
[/spoiler]

Thanks for playing! We appreciate your dedication and continual support for Until Then! 
Follow the Until Then X account for all the latest updates!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44417352/e2437761a63d7fd745cc126c962cc47fe535d7ec.png

notes.title: New Languages Coming to Until Then!
notes.content:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44417352/43d72d47f109aa749e9a27f989310f09693634df.jpg

Rumor has it that Until Then is being localized into the following new languages: 

Japanese: 日本語版近日公開！
Chinese: 简体中文本地化即将推出！
Filipino: Filipino localization, malapit na!

We are especially excited for Filipino as it is our national language, and it is currently Buwan ng Wika, National Language Month, here in the Philippines for the month of August! 

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44417352/45ad528f19d849cea0062840d5d3003b13324b31.png

These new languages are planned to be ready for you this fall. Comment and let us know which language you are most excited for!
